answer: Capacity here decays: an inlet's quota of actions halves every epoch and is refilled only by burning ferrous at the lagoon, a ledger tying each refill to its funding wallet's history. Inlets whose refills trace to one source collide there, and the k-th linked inlet pays k² ferrous per refill. An honest inlet burns 1 ferrous an epoch, while 1,000 clones burn about 333 million every epoch, indefinitely, since capacity cannot be stockpiled. It breaks if funding trails can be laundered cheaply.
